content.en: Weak greedy algorithms, such as the Weak Chebyshev Greedy Algorithm and Weak Relaxed Greedy Algorithm, are being studied for their properties and convergence theorems in Hilbert spaces and uniformly smooth Banach spaces. These algorithms are found to be more ready for practical implementation and can improve convergence rates for approximation and optimization problems. They are also suitable for sparse representation and can be used to construct sparse minimizers for convex functions. Overall, these algorithms offer efficient and effective methods for various scientific applications.
content.da: Svage grådige algoritmer, såsom Weak Chebyshev Greedy Algorithm og Weak Relaxed Greedy Algorithm, bliver studeret for deres egenskaber og konvergensteoremer i Hilbert-rum og ensartet glatte Banach-rum. Disse algoritmer viser sig at være mere klar til praktisk implementering og kan forbedre konvergenshastigheder for approksimations- og optimeringsproblemer. De er også velegnede til sparsom repræsentation og kan bruges til at konstruere sparsomme minimizere for konvekse funktioner. Samlet set tilbyder disse algoritmer effektive og effektive metoder til forskellige videnskabelige anvendelser.
